## Wave 4 Summary

This wave closes the **kinematic discharge of the 170× re-typing** for the Leggett-channel dark-matter anchor. The substrate fact the wave rests on: the DM mass is **graph-ANCHORED** at the clean inter-band Leggett scale `m_Leggett = Mass_LeggettDM_over_Delta_BCS · Δ_BCS = 11.97 · 0.4642547 = 5.5571 M_KK` (Reading B "graph-unanchored" WITHDRAWN at S116-W3-DISORDER-CLOSURE; C11-conditional on `Γ_grav < H_0`). The structure-formation target `m_target = 170 · Δ_BCS = 78.92 M_KK` is a **separate cross-pillar ratio re-typed OFF the mass axis** — it is NOT a DM mass the substrate spectrum is obliged to produce. Three gates discharge the re-typing from three orthogonal angles:

- **4-1 `CF-S117-FREESTREAM-AT-ANCHOR` [PRIMARY, EVOI-carrying, `[SIGN]`]** — the comoving free-streaming length `λ_fs` at the anchored mass is below the structure-formation threshold, with the **which-velocity pre-registration** the W-2 workshop refinement mandates: the load-bearing coldness source is the ALGEBRAIC `v_fs^{4D} = T^{0i}_{4D}/T^{00} = 0` (CDM-CONSTRUCT-44, 5 proofs S44), and the explicit 2nd moment of the transit-frozen Bogoliubov occupation is carried as a SEPARATE substrate-internal momentum-spread diagnostic, explicitly NOT the 4D free-streaming velocity. This is the EVOI-carrying primary of the whole Q3 leg.
- **4-2 `CF-S117-LEGGETT-COLLECTIVE-CEILING` [COMPANION, low-EVOI]** — the full inter-band pair-transfer diagonalization at `L_max=10` confirms the heaviest PROTECTED collective Leggett mode SATURATES at `frac170 ∈ [0.06, 0.08]` (√N-saturation + continuum-edge cap): the protected collective spectrum cannot reach the 170× target, confirming the re-typing from the collective-mode side.
- **4-3 `CF-S117-LEGGETT-EDGE-AND-STIFFNESS` [landau primary / volovik co-route]** — the DIRECT inter-band read of `(ω_Leg, ρ_s^⊥, E_edge^⊥)` settles the CONVENTION + SHARPNESS question: under Convention M the anchor is `x^⊥ = ω_Leg/E_edge^⊥ = 2.53 > 1` ABOVE the `√ρ_s`-free SHARP-MODE ceiling `E_edge^⊥ = 4.73·Δ_BCS` (eq(15c) WITHDRAWN). This adjudicates convention/sharpness; survival is **Reading A** (CPT + GGE integrability + `Γ_grav<H_0`) on either verdict.

**Carry-forward source.** 4-1 and 4-2 are the W3 WP carry-forwards; 4-3 is the W-2 workshop math CF (`CF-S117-LEGGETT-EDGE-AND-STIFFNESS`). The two-observable separation the W-2 workshop established — **relic SURVIVAL** (`N_DM = Σ_k n(k)`, Reading A, registered C11-conditional) ⊥ **Leggett-mode SHARPNESS** (linewidth, below-edge kinematics, `[CONJECTURE S117]`) — is the load-bearing structural frame for the entire wave: NONE of these three gates touches survival, which is settled by Reading A regardless of every kinematic verdict here.

Wave 4 is **substantially self-contained** (the three gates are independent of one another and run in parallel) with two soft upstream couplings, neither a hard block:

| **FREE-STREAMING-58** (S58 W3-15, PASS: `z_tr = 6.75e29 ≫ 6.2e7`, 22 OOM margin) | 4-1 (prior anchor + threshold source) | **AVAILABLE** (closed S58). 4-1 re-anchors this PASS at the S116 graph-anchored mass with the explicit 2nd moment + which-velocity guard; it CITES (does not recompute) the closed result and cross-checks against `computations/session-58/s58_free_streaming.npz`. |

## §W4-2. CF-S117-LEGGETT-COLLECTIVE-CEILING

```yaml
# ---- Identity (7 fields) ----
gate_id: "CF-S117-LEGGETT-COLLECTIVE-CEILING"
schema_version: "R3"
gate_type: "compute"
trigger: "[CHAIN]"
classification: "PHONONIC"
agent_type: "landau-condensed-matter-theorist"
hypothesis: "The heaviest PROTECTED inter-band collective Leggett mode, read from the full inter-band pair-transfer diagonalization across all (p,q) at L_max=10, SATURATES at frac170 = m_heaviest_protected/(170·Δ_BCS) ∈ [0.06, 0.08] (√N-saturation + continuum-edge cap) — the protected collective spectrum cannot reach the 170× structure-formation target."

method:
  description: >
    Diagonalize the full inter-band relative-phase (Leggett) pair-transfer Hamiltonian across
    all Peter-Weyl (p,q) sectors with p+q ≤ 10 (L_max=10), on the off-(0,0) blocks of the
    block-diagonal D_K (wall #2: D_K = ⊕_{(p,q)} D_{(p,q)}; each sector diagonalized
    INDEPENDENTLY — no 155984×155984 dense storage). Read the heaviest collective mode that is
    PROTECTED (below its inter-band continuum edge E_edge^⊥), and form
    frac170 = m_heaviest_protected / (170·Δ_BCS). The protected ceiling is set by the
    inter-band continuum edge cap — the single-fiber ladder top at L_max=10 is
    max|λ| = 0.633·√C_2(10,0) + 0.555 = 4.72 M_KK = 10.17·Δ_BCS (collab eq 1 / HIGH-PW-51;
    C_2 = (p²+q²+pq+3p+3q)/3) — and by √N-saturation of the inter-band pair-transfer coupling
    J_⊥ (bounded by the fiber-gap scale). Confirm frac170 lands in [0.06, 0.08] (≈ 11.97/170 =
    0.0704, the anchor IS the heaviest protected collective mode). A value ≫ 0.08 would reopen
    Tier 2 (the protected spectrum reaching toward the 170× target).
  producing_script: "computations/session-117/s117_w4_leggett_collective_ceiling.py"

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) ----
operator:
  type: "span"
  form: "frac170 = m_heaviest_protected/(170·Δ_BCS) ∈ [0.06, 0.08]"

strict_PASS_boundary:
  value: "[0.06, 0.08]"
  direction: "="                         # set-membership in the pre-registered band (PASS iff frac170 ∈ band)

boundary_reachable_analytically:
  bool: true
  proof_ref: "frac170 saturation substitution chain below: the inter-band continuum edge cap (single-fiber ladder top 0.633·√C_2(10,0)+0.555 = 10.17·Δ_BCS) + √N-saturation bound m_heaviest_protected ≈ 11.97·Δ_BCS ⇒ frac170 ≈ 11.97/170 = 0.0704 ∈ [0.06,0.08] analytically; the diagonalization confirms it numerically"

reachable_rationals:
  includes_integer_mesh: true
  mesh_density: "discrete — the (p,q) sectors with p+q ≤ 10 (a finite Peter-Weyl mesh)"

machinery_pin_map:
  N_eval: "all (p,q) sectors with p+q ≤ 10 (the L_max=10 Peter-Weyl decomposition; 66 sectors counting (p,q) ordered pairs)"
  L_max: 10
  scan_range: "(p,q): p ≥ 0, q ≥ 0, p+q ≤ 10 (off-(0,0): exclude (0,0) for the inter-band pair-transfer)"
  step_size: "N/A — discrete sector enumeration"
  tolerance: "1e-9 (eigenvalue, relative)"
  scheme: "INTER-BAND-PAIR-TRANSFER"
  convention: "PROTECTED-CEILING-frac170"
  random_seed: "N/A — deterministic"
  GPU_path: "torch.linalg (AMD RX 9070 XT; per-(p,q) block Hermitian eigendecomposition; D_K block-diagonal ⇒ largest single block at L_max=10 is well under the 17.1 GB VRAM cap — the L_max=15 (15,0)/(0,15) block dim 9792 = 1.53 GB sets the worst-case envelope, L_max=10 is smaller; feasibility per math-scripts.md §D_K Block-Diagonality)"
  # regulator_pin: N/A — no Seeley-DeWitt a_n cited (E_n is the empirical HIGH-PW-51 ladder scaling, not a regulator-tagged moment)

audit_discriminators:
  audit_sha256_inputs: ["script", "canonical", "pinmap"]
  content_sha256_inputs: ["script"]

substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "frac170 = m_heaviest_protected/(170·Δ_BCS) ≤ 0.08 — the protected collective Leggett
            spectrum SATURATES below the 170× structure-formation target."

    Step 1 (definition): m_heaviest_protected = the heaviest inter-band collective Leggett mode
            that is PROTECTED, i.e. below its inter-band two-quasiparticle continuum edge E_edge^⊥
            (a protected/sharp mode, not a continuum resonance).
    Step 2 (continuum-edge cap): E_edge^⊥ = Δ_BCS + |λ|_fib, with the single-fiber ladder top at
            L_max=10 set by the empirical scaling max|λ| = 0.633·√C_2(p,q) + 0.555
            [collab eq 1, HIGH-PW-51, atlas-spectral-geometer-collab.md], giving at (10,0):
            0.633·√C_2(10,0) + 0.555 = 4.72 M_KK = 10.17·Δ_BCS.   [the L_max=10 fiber-ladder ceiling]
    Step 3 (√N-saturation): the inter-band pair-transfer coupling J_⊥ is bounded by the fiber-gap
            scale (|λ|_fib ≥ √3, Lichnerowicz), so the collective mode mass m ∝ √J_⊥ does NOT grow
            without bound with the sector count N — it SATURATES at the continuum-edge-capped
            band, m_heaviest_protected ≈ O(10·Δ_BCS).
    Step 4 (substitute the anchor): the graph-anchored Leggett mode IS the heaviest protected
            collective mode, m_heaviest_protected = m_Leggett = 11.97·Δ_BCS, so
            frac170 = (11.97·Δ_BCS)/(170·Δ_BCS) = 11.97/170 = 0.07041.
    Step 5 (read off): 0.07041 ∈ [0.06, 0.08]  ⇒  frac170 ≤ 0.08.
    Canonical form: frac170 = m_heaviest_protected/(170·Δ_BCS) ≈ 0.07 ≪ 1.
    Direction: frac170 is BOUNDED ABOVE near 0.07 (the continuum-edge cap + √N-saturation prevent
            the protected collective spectrum from approaching the 170× target).
    Conclusion: the 170× target is UNREACHABLE by the protected collective spectrum — the
            re-typing (off the mass axis) is confirmed from the collective-mode side.
            PASS = frac170 ∈ [0.06,0.08]; frac170 ≫ 0.08 would reopen Tier 2 (NOT expected).
```

## Wave 4 → Wave 5 Decision Point

Wave 4 has **no downstream Wave-5 consumer** — Wave 5 (feynman-theorist, modulus a₄ gradient & WDW geometry) is structurally independent. Wave 4's outputs flow OUTWARD to curated registers, not to a successor compute wave:

| 4-gate outcome | Consumer | Action |
|:---------------|:---------|:-------|
| **4-1 PASS** (λ_fs < threshold, cold) | `framework-dm-properties.md` free-streaming-horizon row + falsifier inventory DM-structure-formation row (mack sole-writer) | mack updates the free-streaming row at the graph-anchored mass with the which-velocity tag; the 170× re-typing is recorded DISCHARGED on the free-streaming axis. |
| **4-1 FAIL** (T^{0i}_4D ≠ 0 channel found) | CDM-CONSTRUCT-43/44 re-examination | route a dedicated next-session gate re-testing the 5-proof theorem (a substrate-physics surprise — NOT a broadband-n(k) reading). |
| **4-2 PASS** (frac170 ∈ [0.06,0.08]) | §VII protection-magnitude-exclusion / SHARP-mode-ceiling characterization (mack) | record the collective-mode-side confirmation of the re-typing. |
| **4-2 FAIL** (frac170 ≫ 0.08) | Tier-2 reopening | route a re-examination of the continuum-edge-cap / √N-saturation argument. |
| **4-3 PASS-A** (x^⊥ > 1, Convention M) | §VII theorem re-scope (eq(15c) WITHDRAWN → SHARP-mode ceiling 4.73·Δ_BCS); the `[CONJECTURE S117]` sharpness sub-row (mack) | mack lands the eq(15c)→characterization re-scope + the light-vs-heavy DE-inheritance scope note (the W-2 Effected-In-Session ROUTE-1/ROUTE-2 items). |
| **4-3 PASS-B / INFO** (restoring-scale convention or marginal) | convention re-adjudication | carry-forward the direct-χ_- edge re-run as a sharpness CF (survival unchanged, Reading A). |

**Cross-cutting (all three gates):** every Wave-4 verdict is a kinematic/sharpness statement and NONE touches relic SURVIVAL, which the W-2 workshop settled is Reading A (registered atlas-04 C11-conditional). The wave's collective output is "the 170× re-typing is discharged on three orthogonal axes (free-streaming, collective-ceiling, edge/sharpness), and below-edge is confirmed as the LIGHT mode's property — NOT the heavy anchor's survival mechanism."

**Feasibility (`.claude/rules/math-scripts.md §"D_K Block-Diagonality + Recursive-Casimir-Projection Feasibility"`):** 4-2 and 4-3 diagonalize per-(p,q) blocks at L_max=10 — D_K is block-diagonal so no dense ≥640k×640k storage is needed; the worst-case single block fits the 17.1 GB VRAM cap with margin > 11× (the L_max=15 (15,0)/(0,15) block at 1.53 GB sets the envelope; L_max=10 is smaller). Inter-band irrep construction at p+q ≤ 10 is feasible within an agent timeslot (the infeasible regime is p+q ≥ 13). The protected ceiling is Casimir-bound-saturated at modest p+q (the heaviest protected mode comes from the low fiber sectors), so a Friedrich-Bär / Casimir-bound truncation-consistency check guards against a high-(p,q) construction stall.
